definitions.full: H6867. tsarebeth [ צָרָב ] adjective burning, scorching (= * צַרָּב Thes and others); — צָרָ֑בֶת כְּאֵשׁ Prov 16:27 (simile of words.). צָרֶ֫בֶת noun feminine scab, scar , of a sore (literally a burning, scorching ); — construct הִוא הַשְּׁחִין צָרֶבֶת Lev 13:23 ; ׳צ הִוא הַמִּכְוָה 13:28 .
